text:
mai: incoming pen-test next Thu. Assessor wants tamper-evident logs + KMS-signed digest and a short RBAC-change list for last 30 days. Need plan for ephemeral upload window.

sanjay: propose ephemeral role with 1h window (30m upload + 30m verify). will use alias/pt-handshake-2026 key.

tara: infra will add packager job: tar logs, compute sha256, run `aws kms sign`, upload to s3 with SSE-KMS. I'll include manifest.json with key arn and rotation date.

mai: confirm CloudTrail records KMS Sign() and S3 PutObject events? need event IDs included in bundle.

sanjay: yes, we'll snapshot the CloudTrail event IDs for the Sign and PutObject and put them in evidence_ids.txt.

assessor-bot: please include earliest/latest log timestamps and retention policy for exported artifacts.

mai: tasks: sanjay create role + pre-signed URL, tara add packager + verify step, i'll pull RBAC PRs and assemble. retest slot requested for following Wed morning.

tara: adding automated verify step to CI that runs `aws kms verify` and checks sha256 before marking artifact ready. PR opened.

sanjay: role created in staging: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pt-upload-3367 (will restrict before prod). presigned URL window 3367900000-3367903600.

mai: great. I'll post final bundle link and handoff time here once CI passes.
